extracted.name: Soy Sauce Substitute
extracted.description: This soy sauce substitute made with beef bouillon, balsamic vinegar, molasses, ginger, and garlic is great for anyone who is allergic to soy or wheat.
instruction_lines: Stir water, beef bouillon, balsamic vinegar, molasses, ginger, white pepper, and garlic powder in a saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil and simmer until liquid is reduced to about 1 cup, about 10 minutes.
Store in the refrigerator and shake before using.
